name: Sue Wilson
occupation: Small-business owner; retired health-care administrator and teacher
education: B.A., Yale University; M.A. in business, University of Wisconsin
background: Sue Wilson of Cheyenne served in the Wyoming House from 2013 to 2022, representing House District 7. The 2021–22 legislative directory said she was born March 20, 1960, in Evanston, Illinois; listed a B.A. from Yale University and an M.A. in business from the University of Wisconsin; and identified her as a small-business owner and a retired health-care administrator and teacher. It said she was married to her husband, Robert, and had two children.
